entries.title: Numbers 33:1
segments: The journeys of the children of Israel; the places mentioned from

, are those through which the Israelites passed during their wanderings in the wilderness, and on their way from Egypt to Canaan. 
 
Human life is a journey from the cradle to the grave, and each day carries us one day nearer to our final, our eternal abode.

entries.title: Numbers 33:2
segments: It is often useful to look back on the various stages of our past life, to recount the goodness of God, and sometimes to write down portions of our history for the benefit of others.

entries.title: Numbers 33:49
segments: However long our journey, or whatever be our course through time, we shall soon come to its close and pass into eternity.

entries.title: Numbers 33:52
segments:
Pictures; sculptured figures used, as well as the "molten images" or idols, for idolatrous purposes. 
 
Occasions of sin, temptations to evil, and whatever tends to draw our hearts from God and unfit us for heaven, should be carefully avoided.

entries.title: Numbers 33:55
segments:
Pricks--and thorns; sources of vexation and distress. 
 
Our fleshly lusts and sinful habits of every kind are to our souls what the Canaanites were to the ancient Israelites.  If we spare them, or continue to indulge them, they will continue to torment us, and ultimately prove our ruin.

entries.title: Numbers 33:56
segments: Do unto you, as I thought to do unto them; expel you from your country and destroy you.
